channel.title: Fort Worth Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fort Worth Magazine (fwtx.com)

item.title: Could Texas Republicans Repeat the Mistake That Elected John Tower in 1961?
item.description: Political fractures inside the Texas GOP could create the same kind of opening that allowed Republican John Tower to win a U.S. Senate seat in 1961.

item.title: Casa Mañana Unleashes ‘Hairspray’ — and Its Uplifting Message Is Likely to Stick
item.description: As ‘Hairspray’ ends its run at Casa Mañana this weekend, we chat with the show's leading lady about the can't-miss musical and how much literal hairspray their wig designer burns through.

item.title: After Medical Emergency, GoFundMe Launched to Support Bowie House GM and His Family
item.description: Gaylord Lamy, who's been the only general manager of the Auberge Collection hotel, suffered a heart attack in late February.

item.title: Debunking the Myth of the Quiet Cowboy
item.description: There aren’t many public speaking competitions that require being a cowboy as a prerequisite, but we know of at least one that happened right here in Fort Worth.

item.title: Texas Wesleyan Promotes Fran Johnson to Head Football Coach
item.description: The Rams elevate their longtime offensive coordinator after a stretch that included the nation’s top scoring offense and consecutive NAIA playoff appearances.

item.title: This Rodeo Puts Five-Figure Checks in the Pockets of 12-Year-Olds
item.description: There’s not always an age requirement for the biggest checks in the rodeo world, and the kids competing at the 2026 Hooey Junior Patriot could be cashing in their richest yet

item.title: Don't Let the Name Fool You, Fort Worth Zoo's 'Lesser' Flamingos Are Pretty Great
item.description: The zoo's new hatchlings are a massive part of one of the world’s most successful lesser flamingo breeding programs.

item.title: This 3,000+ Acre Ranch Two Hours From Fort Worth Has Us Swooning
item.description: Spring Mesa Ranch includes a 16,000-square-foot home and is currently listed for $23.5 million.

item.title: Does Your Horse Need an Attorney? Emma Grotting's on the Case
item.description: Peek inside the world of a Weatherford-based farm and ranch attorney who serves a client base ranging from two to four legs, mustaches to manes, and net worths in the millions.

item.title: Armadillo Races in the Stockyards — How Fort Worth Celebrates St. Paddy's Day
item.description: A roundup of six weekend events where you're gonna see a lot of green, but it's still unmistakably Cowtown.
